summary: Recognize modern rocket-return science through payload, silo and construction acquisition.
details: Factorio 2.0/2.1 launch products use the existing typed solver for their payload, obtainable fixed-recipe silo and construction inputs. The selected source retains all research gates without inventing a recipe output for the returned pack.

Construction shares the silo surface and input-port requirements; discarded recipe products remain unavailable. Existing researchability checks reject self-locks and cycles, preserve independent unlock alternatives and continue to apply bounded diagnostic work limits.

Controlled LAUNCH01-LAUNCH19 cases cover this source contract. Actual current-package launches, catalogue changes, production and save qualification remain pending under A04; platform logistics and historical launch contracts are not newly qualified.
